title: Graduation Procession in Academic Regalia, 1966 University Snapshot Photo
description: A group of academics wearing black gowns, hoods, and mortarboards walk in an outdoor commencement procession across a university campus. In the background, a crowd of seated attendees watches beneath sunny skies, with mid-century modern campus architecture and landscaped trees framing the scene. Stamped on the bottom white margin with 'FEB 1966'.
